name: Karam Karam Masala Bites
ingredients_raw: Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil, Cottonseed Oil), Corn Meal (27%), Rice Meal (27%), Gram Meal (3%), Ground Spices & Condiments (Dry Mango, Coriander, Dehydrated (Tomato, Garlic & Onion), Red Chilli, Cumin, Dry Ginger), lodised Salt, Sugar, Maltodextrin, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Flavour Enhancer (INS 631, INS 627), Natural Colour (INS 160c), Anti Caking Agent (INS 551), Added Natural & Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Onion) CONTAINS: ADDED FLAVOURS (NATURAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES) AND PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOURS (INS 160c) ALLERGEN ADVICE: This product is made in a facility that processes food containing peanut, treenut, soy, milk, cereals containing gluten, sesame, mustard, and sulphites.
